mechanism_narrative: The sharp drop in WORKPLACES at t-0w indicates fewer commuting trips, and this suppresses discretionary shopping with a 2-4 week lag. If commuter traffic does not recover soon, RETAIL_REC should remain below its prior four-week average.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean while WORKPLACES stays at or below the t-0w level for the next 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls more than 10 points week-on-week, access to central retail districts weakens immediately and retail visitation declines over the following week. The t-0w collapse in TRANSIT should therefore precede lower RETAIL_REC next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline in the next week after a TRANSIT drop exceeding 10 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in RESIDENTIAL and fall in TRANSIT indicates more time spent at home and less out-of-home circulation, which shifts spending away from retail precincts over the next 2-4 weeks. The latest t-0w pattern should therefore depress RETAIL_REC.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 2 weeks despite RESIDENTIAL remaining elevated and TRANSIT remaining depressed relative to t-1w.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain more than 15 points below their t-2w levels, the city is in a tighter activity regime that cuts casual retail trips. Under that regime, RETAIL_REC should be lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both fall > 15 points below their t-2w levels
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not below its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days while both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay more than 15 points below t-2w.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS mobility can displace weekend leisure from retail centers toward outdoor recreation, reducing retail-and-recreation visits over a 2-week horizon. The recent PARKS weakening at t-0w should be followed by a short-run rebound in RETAIL_REC only if park use stops expanding.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall over the next 2 weeks after PARKS remains elevated relative to t-2w.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC indicates broad reluctance to make nonessential trips, and that aversion should persist for one more week before easing. With GROCERY_PHARM at t-0w also falling, RETAIL_REC should stay weak next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises in the next week while GROCERY_PHARM remains below its t-1w level.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT stays below -55 and WORKPLACES stays below -25, mobility restrictions are binding enough to suppress retail foot traffic with a 4-week lag. The current t-0w readings satisfy that regime, implying lower RETAIL_REC over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not lower over the next 28 days when TRANSIT stays below -55 and WORKPLACES stays below -25.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL remains elevated while PARKS and TRANSIT both remain depressed, people are substituting home-based time for shopping trips. That combination should keep RETAIL_REC below its recent average over the next 2-4 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean despite RESIDENTIAL staying elevated and both PARKS and TRANSIT remaining depressed.
